title: Additive functors induce triangulated functors on homotopy categories
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], and let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be an additive functor. Give their homotopy categories of $\mathbf Z$-indexed cochain complexes the standard cone triangulations [lem-pur-homotopy-category-triangulated]. The functor $K(F):K(\mathcal A)\to K(\mathcal B)$ obtained by applying $F$ termwise to complexes and to homotopy classes of maps, equipped with the canonical commutation isomorphisms with integer shifts, carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles; hence $K(F)$ is a triangulated functor [def-weil-triangulated-category].

Auxiliary input: Local complete-intersection determinant adjunction underlying the marked dualizing construction, before the marking is inserted. Supporting ring/sheaf input: Transitivity triangle for ring cotangent complexes. Generic homological input to the category bar resolution: Unbounded derived lower shriek for continuous and cocontinuous site functors.
